text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This brings me closer. One step closer to 
completing my formula for victory...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This brings me closer. One step closer to 
completing my formula for victory...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Then allow me to say something 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"This victory belongs to us. To the two of 
us who run in pursuit of the ultimate."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"In our next race as well, I shall prove 
my theory correct. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I promise we will celebrate victory 
together like this once again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Getting carried away will only trip me 
up. I must look not just at what won the 
race, but where the cracks appeared.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Early positioning, timing the move... Did 
we make a mistake somewhere? There's 
endless material to review.
choice_data_list: Let's do a review right away.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! Thanks to you, I've got my 
game face on and tightened my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll be counting on you going forward as 
well.
